P1 Required Revision: Record both sides of database ownership atomically. The ownership record remains asymmetric: only a fake boot writes a mark, while an unmarked database is treated as eligible even though it may be a fresh/reset persistent database or one whose real-Stripe initialization failed before populating the mirror. A concurrent live and fake boot can likewise both observe the unmarked

P1 Required Revision: Make the credential guard syntax-complete. The recorded oracle only matches dot access such as process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_TEST; it misses computed access (process.env["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_TEST"]), destructuring, and dynamic helpers, all patterns already used for other environment variables in this repository (falClient.ts, asyncJobs.ts, userImageUpload.ts). P1 Required Revision: Remove the stale no-event-ingress requirement. This settled decision still says no event can enter under fake, but decision 6 and the Proposed Design explicitly preserve the admin-authenticated /admin/stripe/test-event path. The implementation specification now contains mutually exclusive requirements, so an implementer could remove or disable the route to satisfy this paragr

P1 Required Revision: Make fake seeding part of server readiness. The ownership check is awaited, but the fake's baseline seed has no readiness guarantee. P2 Required Revision: Disable payment controls when the driver is absent. In the supported unset-driver state, keeping existing controls unchanged leaves dead UI. /admin/stripe/sync, /full-sync and /sync/status all require getStripeSync() so cannot work; routes/stripe.ts still reads persisted mirror rows and the Pricing page can render checkout actions that must fail at getUncachableStripeClient()

P2 Required Revision: Require cleanup for the real payment UAT. The end-to-end payment flow mutates both the persistent Stripe test account and the Repl's persistent development database, but the plan specifies no test identity, captured baseline, cancellation/refund, or local entitlement verification after cleanup.
